paragraphs: Rabbi Hillel bar Hilani; Vayikra Rabbah 12:5. Eichah Rabbah 2:12 has the reading Rabbi Ilam.[^1][^2]

notes.text: Hillel bar Hilani and Ilam are the competing readings attributed to the two Midrash sources.

The whole named Torat Emet Vayikra Rabbah 12:5 and Eikhah Rabbah 2:12 explicitly give Rabbi Hillel bar Hilni and Rabbi Ilam respectively. The supplied Hilani transliteration and the current note remain unchanged; the textual comparison is not a father or identity merge.
